title: Doctoral Research Opportunities
summary: Applications are invited from motivated candidates interested in pursuing doctoral research at INSpIRE Lab. Kindly email me (gowtham@iitism.ac.in) with your CV and research interests. Keep the subject line
eligibility: Should have relevant experience in numerical techniques and software like ABAQUS, COMSOL, and/or OpenSees, apart from requirements applicable to IIT (ISM) PhD admission
